notes.content:

BUG FIXES[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where a connected receiver, when added to the inventory, would still have its cable visually attached to the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where interactions could still be triggered from long distances.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.content: [p]The interaction system no longer responds to number keys alone. Selection is now performed using the [b]Number key + E[/b] combination[/p]

notes.title: Alpha Demo is Available Now !
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662404/822aa5edf1207f6c0439913d5528a7f754f81cc3.gif"][/img]
[/p][p]Our first public demo is live as part of the Steam [b]Automation Fest![/b] Build a network, optimize it and 
witness some strange events in the dim halls of an apartment building. [/p][p][/p][p]This alpha version includes the core gameplay loop: placing recorders, building receiver networks, collecting sounds, and sending reports. [/p][p][/p][p]There’s much more to come, this is just the beginning. [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2714150/discussions/0/582769417678659952/"]Check out our roadmap here[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p]We're excited to share this first step with you and would love to hear your feedback. Thanks for supporting Beyond the Doors! [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/YtBQfajnpM"]Join our Discord[/url] to leave feedback, report issues, or chat with the devs and other players. [/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2714150/discussions/0/582769417678659952/"]Check out the Roadmap[/url] to see what’s coming next. [/p]
